input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Developer roles. It exposes interfaces for managing captcha endpoint. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to interact with captcha endpoint functionality, so that I can accomplish my captcha endpoint-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Developer, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Developer, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
